'''Raenyn''' was a young [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustan]] child who lived at the [[Krevk Settlement]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Gelgelar/Legends|Gelgelar]]. Along with another young child, they captured a [[Reeho (bird)|reeho]] with the intent of keeping it as a pet, unaware that [[T'laerean Larn]] had used [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to merge with the [[Bird/Legends|bird's]] mind.<ref name="BG" />
